visual.description: Full-width hero with centered large typography over gradient background and horizontal nav bar at top.
Two large portrait images flanking centered text block in the middle, creating a three-zone layout.
Similar three-zone layout with left portrait, centered text, and smaller right portrait at different vertical alignment.
Two main article cards side by side, each with large image, title, category tag, and read time.
Three-column article grid with varied image sizes and layouts, left card has single image, right has image collage.
Centered heading and subtext above large illustration, with centered CTA button below.
Full-width quote section with large text on left two-thirds and signature with attribution on right third.
Centered heading with horizontal tab navigation below, followed by full-width hero image for selected tab content.
Centered product description above, then multi-column footer with logo, nav links in groups, and copyright info.
